registry_purpose: Pre-registered FMD-06/07/08 experiment matrix, frozen before any model is fit, to reduce researcher degrees of freedom and prevent post-hoc result chasing. No performance value of any kind appears in this file.
fmd05r_correction: unit_of_analysis is forecast_origin for every RISK experiment below, so every 'cohort' field states the TRUE origin-level count (3,761 FIT_DEVELOPMENT / 541 HELD_OUT_FROM_MODEL_FITTING / 20 SRI_LANKA_TRANSFER_CASE_STUDY, summing to forecast_origin_count=4,322) rather than FMD-05's original, mislabeled EVENT-level counts (6,799 / 2,492 / 20, summing to the INCLUDED event count 9,311) -- see FMD_SPLIT_PROTOCOL.md section 0 and FMD_COHORT_MANIFEST.json's forecast_origin_role_counts vs. included_source_event_role_counts.
